observations.why: Directive issued in settled, confident register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm, conveying satisfaction at putting a system in place.
Aphoristic assertion carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is framed as no rollback at all, injecting alarm to motivate the directive.
Restating the cadence as a settled bullet point — low arousal, positive valence of a plan now in place.
Self-assignment framed as a neutral label — settled acceptance of responsibility without heightened affect.

mints.name: StakesAsAbsenceRhetoric
mints.title: a practice we have not rehearsed is a practice we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker escalating urgency by framing the absence of a habit as the absence of the capability itself?
